title: Disappointing
body:
Personally, I struggle to find the correct style of music that works for me. I signed up for the short trial period with Brain.fm, but being neurodiverse, I unfortunately forgot to cancel the trial before the subscription renewed.

I emailed support requesting cancellation, however I did not receive a reply.

The yearly subscription also seems significantly more expensive compared to other providers that offer a broader platform and, in some cases, better value for a much lower cost. I would genuinely be happy to pay a premium price if the service offered something substantially different or unique compared to competitors.

There are also some very good focus and relaxation videos available for free on YouTube, which makes the pricing harder to justify.

I do feel there should be greater awareness around how trial subscriptions can disproportionately affect neurodivergent users, particularly those with ADHD who may struggle with time management, reminders, and cancelling subscriptions within short trial windows.

If this has happened to you as well, I would encourage you to escalate the issue and provide feedback to apple

title: AI-created music that helps productivity & relaxation
body: I'm a big fan of Brain.fm. I don't like working in silence, but I find music with lyrics too distracting. I even find music with strong melodies distracting, so I often listen to "spa music" or nature sounds. However, although relaxing, they're not conducive to focussed work. The AI-created music, with three modes "Focus", Relax" and "Sleep"" is pleasantly melodic, without being distracting, and I find that on "Focus" with the music and driving beats I get a good 30-45 minutes of highly focussed productivity (be it design work, writing, or doing accounts!). After a short break I can do it again. I personally find this a productive way to work. I sincerely credit Brain-FM with helping me in the final stages of my Master's Degree. I was anxious and stressed, and Brain.fm helped me write for long day and night stretches with "Focus" music, and take "power naps" with the "Relax" music. I highly recommend people give it a try. Personally I signed up for a subscription before the free trial was up as it was so effective!

title: Interesting app

I haven’t taken up subscription since it struck me that there is so much better music out there which has been composed and played by real people (rather than AI) who could do with us buying their music. Try ENO, Basinski, Aphex Twins, Keith Jarrett, Pole, The Necks or spread your wings to Mozart, Bach, Satie, David Lang, Max Richter, Arvo Part, Murcof, Gyorgy Ligeti. The list is enormous and all have created and some are creating work that can be listened in the background yet is able put you in another place without intrusion. But I do like the idea of the app and would enjoy it if it used music created by people. Maybe it does and the trial time didn’t give me time to find it. If so then let me know and I shall have another go!

title: Fantastic app that really works
body:
I’ve been using this since it started some years ago and what I’ve loved seeing is the continued development and evolution of the app, as it’s expanded its offering.

I originally only used it when I needed to concentrate at work. I found if I listened to normal music when I was working, I’d start listening to the lyrics and distracting myself from the task in hand. That’s doesn’t happen with Brain.fm as you quickly stop “hearing” the music; sure it’s there but you don’t focus on it and you brain gets into gear with the task you need to focus on.

Lately I’ve been using some of the sleep functions; maybe if I’ve been jet lagged after a flight or just when trying to sleep earlier than normal. It really works! Last night I had an amazing deep sleep and woke up so refreshed, it was amazing.

Thanks so much for the developers and I really do recommend this awesome app.

There are however problems with the app. Every time I open it I have to do it several times, because it crashes. Sometimes during long session, the music just stops and I have to go back to the app to resume it. The logo of the app also I find not very well-designed.

Having said all of this technical disadvantages, still, the content is so good that I have to leave a five-star review. Although I wish these issues were fixed.

body:
